name: Luis Ignatius Peñalver y Cárdenas
contribution: A Cuban Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of New Orleans, and as Archbishop of Guatemala.

checks.lead: Luis Ignatius Peñalver y Cárdenas (3 April 1749 – 17 July 1810) was a Cuban Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of New Orleans, and as Archbishop of Guatemala.
